title: Ruling on key sealed document in Brian Flores case is also under seal, for now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ruling on key sealed document in Brian Flores case is also under seal, for now
sources.description: The Brian Flores case against the NFL and several teams (Dolphins, Texans, Giants, and Broncos) has recently focused on a document produced by Korn Ferry, in connection with a coaching search the company performed for the Ravens.
